methods.purpose: inspect actual acoustic signal for speech, music and distinct sound-event candidates; this is separate from subtitle/ASR text

findings.speech: Speech is detected in every contiguous inspection window, consistent with continuous narration across the clip.
findings.music: Music is detected in all three coarse windows and all nine localization windows. The bounded acoustic evidence supports a continuous background music bed across 0-22.466938 seconds.
findings.soundEffects: No distinct sound effect is established with stable localization. Low and inconsistent ding/ping/throat-clearing candidates may be music transients or speech-model confusions; they are not promoted to positive SFX facts.
findings.disputedPOrPi: The heard syllable represented by P图 and 批图 is homophonic in this context; the complete audio pass and fresh ASR cannot establish Chinese orthography. With no burned caption after 16.333 seconds, P图 versus 批图 remains unresolved.
findings.narrativeRole: The music bed supports continuous pacing/energy beneath the narration; no separately identifiable sound-effect cue is evidenced strongly enough to assign a narrative role.

limitations: AudioSet labels are probabilistic proposals and can confuse music transients with sound effects or speech artifacts.
This pass establishes acoustic presence, not music title, composer, ownership or license.
P图 and 批图 cannot be distinguished by sound alone because the pronunciation is the same; orthography requires a visual/text source that is absent in the closing interval.
The failed Gemini CLI attempt produced no evidence and is not used in reconstruction.
